topic: Data model and frequency formula updates
summary_markdown:
Multiple data issues were addressed. First, for company 7932 in Malaysia, the session aggregation issue was resolved and confirmed as fixed.
Second, a new frequency formula was deployed to production (prod) and later updated on staging. The model build status was discussed; it was clarified that the `device_session_concept` model is used, not necessarily requiring a full rebuild if only session data was copied from `device_session_trusted`. 
Finally, the deployment of the frequency formula to staging was confirmed for the relevant campaign (7894).
decisions: Session aggregation issue for company 7932 is fixed.
New frequency formula deployed to production and updated on staging.
